main_measure.name: mean short-direction unusual 20-bar move per case
main_measure.threshold: confirm t >= 2 over >= 20 cases with rank correlation > 0; reject t <= -2 over >= 20 cases

supporting_check.name: Spearman rank correlation of |entry forecast| vs short-direction unusual move

decided_by: t lies between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: A case is the first short bet (a rise of at least 2 forecast points in short size from its lowest level since the last bet) in each 20-bar grid cell of a window, dropped when its 20-bar return would leave the window, with drift the coin's mean non-overlapping 20-bar return over all its windows.
